name: hmi_create_connection
description: Create or configure an integrated HMI connection between an HMI target and a partner PLC device/CPU.

connection_name.description: Name of the HMI connection to create (e.g. 'HMI_PLC_1_Connection').

device_name.description: Target HMI device or software name (optional, defaults to first HMI target).

disabled_at_startup.description: Whether the connection is disabled at startup (default: false).

partner_plc_name.description: Name of the partner PLC device in the project (e.g. 'PLC_1').
